For Mum: how to use this
  1. This page works with no Wi-Fi. Do not close the page on the plane.
  2. Tap Mock test. Tap the big yellow button. Listen to the voice.
  3. Eirini writes the words on paper, or with her finger in the box.
  4. Tap Show answer. Compare the shapes of the characters, one by one.
  5. All correct? Tap the green button. A mistake? Tap the orange button. Mistakes come back at the end.
  6. Use headphones on the plane. Tap Slow if the voice is too fast.
  • Part A (30 marks): 10 of these 13 words.
  • Part B (60 marks): Lesson 10, paragraphs 5, 6, 8 and 9.
  • Part C (10 marks): two extra sentences (課外一, 課外二).
  • Bonus (20 marks): idioms, book 2, pages 9 to 14. The teacher gives the idioms. Eirini puts each idiom in the correct sentence. The practice sentences in this game are new. They are not the sentences in the book.
Voice: Suk Yee (Cantonese) · ElevenLabs v4
